items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: The interviewee (Ed Garland) does not speak about Hoss. The mention of Hoss comes from the Interviewer ('Hoss told me about that') and another speaker (Floyd Levin). The interviewee only asks 'Who was Allen?' in response to the interviewer's mention of Hoss, indicating no direct personal interaction

ctx.x: Did you do that? Move your foot in a certain way to keep time when you were taking that.
Yeah. But he didn't show me that. No. And he didn't have no foot work. No. That's why Hoss showed me. You know. It was a time.
